column1: # The machine gallery's table (tools/e2e/gallery.mjs). One line per machine:
# Row = the mod's row in the world and its page on the dashboard. `node tools/e2e/gallery.mjs catalog` adds the blocks a
# running server has cards for; lines starting with "#" stay off (blocks that only fit a generic card). Tokens:
#   fe[=N]            fill with N FE (default 1 000 000) through the energy capability (each machine stands on a full
#                     Powah cell anyway, `nopower` leaves the cell out)
#   item=<id>[*n]     insert items, as a player's hopper would (dev command; default 16)
#   state=[a=b,c=d]   block state  ·  nbt={...} block entity data (spaces written as §)
#   face=up|north|south|east|west  where the uplink sits (default up)  ·  size=N the machine is N blocks wide/high
#   self              the block is its own device: no uplink, nbt={LINK,...} links it to the mainframe
#   note=words_like_this  why values may legitimately be empty, shown in the report
#   kind=<card>       the card the catalog saw (information)
